;Business and economy
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**Both countries announce an initial deal where new tariffs to be mutually imposed on December 15 would not be implemented. China says it "will buy more high quality of American agricultural products", while the United States says it will halve the existing 15% tariffs. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2019/dec/13/china-confirms-phase-one-trade-deal-us-tariffs (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Fourteen people are killed after a van hit a truck loaded with smuggled fuel in [[Killa Saifullah District]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://trt.global/world/article/12731568 (TRT Global)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] releases a report regarding the situation in Chile. The report confirms the existence of severe and reiterative human rights violations, including excessive use of force, arbitrary detentions, torture and sexual violence. [https://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/pais/dd-hh/ddhh-informe-bachelet-consigna-muertes-tortura-y-violencia-sexual/2019-12-13/092349.html (Cooperativa)]
*[[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**An appeals court in [[Ukraine]] confirms the guilty ruling of [[Artem Sytnyk]], head of the [[National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine]], for corruption. Sytnyk was accused of having expensive vacations paid by businessman Mykola Nadeyko. [https://www.unian.info/politics/10794095-elite-leisure-in-rivne-region-court-finds-nabu-head-sytnyk-guilty-of-corruption.html (UNIAN)]
*[[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House Committee on the Judiciary|House Judiciary Committee]] votes along party lines to pass two articles for impeachment against [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. The [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]] is expected to hold two votes, one for each charge, on Wednesday, December 18. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/house-judiciary-committee-set-vote-trump-impeachment-articles/story?id=67706093 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Algerian presidential election]]
**[[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] is elected in the first round. [https://www.npr.org/2019/12/13/787789940/algeria-elects-a-new-president-in-controversial-election (NPR)]
*[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]], [[Boris Johnson]] begins his second term and forms a [[Second Johnson ministry|new majority government]] after winning the [[2019 United Kingdom general election|2019 general election]] by a [[landslide victory|landslide]].  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/election-2019-50765773 (BBC News)]
